36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
137446: Having grown up in the lawless territory known as The Inside, the young Ohma was found and adopted by Tokita Niko, who taught him his style of martial arts; the Niko Style. Ohma is a man of above-average height and has an extremely athletic build.
137447: Imai Cosmo, also known as The King of Stranglers, is one of the affiliated fighters employed for Nishihonji Security Services and also one of Nishihonji's Seven Fists. He represented Nishihonji Security Services during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
143837: Akiyama Kaede is a secretary working for Yamashita Kazuo at Yamashita Trading Co. She formerly worked under Nogi Hideki at the Nogi Group. While she seems like she has a cold persona, the truth is that Kaede is just socially awkward.
143838: He is the CEO of the Yamashita coop.. He is a weak old man, however he is never scared to say his opinion out loud.
143839: Sekibayashi Jun, also known as Hell's Angel, is a famous Super Japan Pro Wrestler as well as an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches. He represented Gandai in the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
143840: Kiryu Setsuna, also known as The Beautiful Beast, is a mysterious individual whose history is closely intertwined with Tokita Ohma's. He was the affiliated fighter for the Koyo Academy Group during the most recent Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
143841: Inaba Ryo, also known as The Black Phantom, is an assassin that hails from the Inaba Clan as well as the clan's current heir. He represented "Penasonic" as their affiliated fighter during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament and was one of three assassins in the tournament.
143842: Sawada Keizaburo is an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches, typically for Murder Music. He represented Murder Music during the most recent Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
143843: Kaneda Suekichi is an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches. He represented Ginokuniya Bookstore during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament after stealing the affiliated fighter's spot from Himuro Ryo.
143844: Known as "The Dissector" (解剖魔, Kaibōma), is a special agent of the government of Japan. During the Kengan Annihilation Tournament, Hanafusa posed as the affiliated fighter for Teito University in order to complete a mission given to him by the Japanese government
143845: Mikazuchi Rei, also known as The Lightning God, is an assassin from the Mikazuchi Clan and the current master of the Raishin Style.
143846: Okubo Naoya, also known as The King of Combat, is the Absolute Champion of the Ultimate Fight MMA promotion. He represented Muji TV as their affiliated fighter during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
143847: Julius Reinhold is an affiliated fighter in the Kengan matches. He represented Toyo Electric Power Co. during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament. He became Iwami Heavy Industries's affiliated fighter during the Kengan Association VS Purgatory Tournament.
143848: Nikaido Ren is the captain of the Heavenly Wolves, a Chinese mercenary group and currently one of Katahara Metsudo's Bodyguards. He represented Byakuya News during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament, after stealing the affiliated fighter position under Toyo Electric Co.'s orders.
143849: Saw Paing is a Burmese fighter with a lean and tall physique. He arguably appears much younger than he is, with a youthful and hairless face and spiky, voluminous brown hair and hazel eyes.
143850: Haruo Kono is a Super Japan Pro Wrestler and an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches. During the Kengan Annihilation Tournament, he represented Nentendo as their affiliated fighter. Originally a Gurkha, his birth name is Haru.
143851: Mokichi Robinson is an Anglican priest and affiliated fighter in the Kengan matches, usually fighting for Sentory. He represented them during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
143852: Meguro Masaki was a murderous mercenary working under Hayami Katsumasa. Under Hayami's orders, he became the affiliated fighter for Umiichi Securities during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
143853: As an experienced "actor" Chiba's true personality is hard to discern as he changes his persona to suit his needs, being able to fluidly and convincingly shift his tone and mood to fit.
143854: Akoya Seishu is a police inspector and the captain of the 44th Riot Squad. He is also a secret vigilante that ruthlessly carries out his brand of justice.
143855: Muteba Gizenga is an infamous blind mercenary from Congo. He was hired by Togo Tomari to represent Iwami Heavy Industries as their affiliated fighter during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
143856: Nogi Hideki is the CEO of Nogi Group and the current chairman of the Kengan Association. Nogi Hideki is an esteemed looking gentleman, always seen wearing the finest threads. He has black hair that is slicked back and wrinkled yet experienced facial features.
143857: Shion is a wary individual with surprisingly masculine tendencies. Her muscle fetish is one of the main reasons she dated Hatsumi. According to her younger sister
143858: Hatsumi is an extremely relaxed and blasé person. This lackadaisical attitude shows in most of his Kengan losses: nine by oversleeping, four from bailing, and two from forgetting there was a match on. However, when he gets serious, he gets serious.
143859: Wakatsuki Takeshi, also known as The Wild Tiger, is the affiliated fighter of Furumi Pharmaceuticals; he represented the company during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
143860: Adam Dudley, also known as The Emperor, is an American street fighter who represented "Boss Burger" during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament. After the tournament, he stayed in Japan, becoming an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches.
143861: A professional boxer and the personal bodyguard of Rama XIII. During the Kengan Annihilation Tournament, he participated as the affiliated fighter for Yato Trading Co.During the Kengan Annihilation Tournament, he participated as the affiliated fighter for Yato Trading Co.
143862: Raian Kure is an assassin from the infamous Kure Clan. He represented Under Mount, Inc. as their affiliated fighter during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament. Two years later, he fought in the Kengan Association VS Purgatory Tournament, representing the Kengan Association.
143863: Rihito is the president of Super Frozen Cold Storage and an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches. He was the first fighter-president in the Kengan Association's history.
143872: Murobuchi Gozo is an affiliated fighter in the Kengan matches and the fighter who represented United Clothing during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament. He was also a legendary decathlete that dominated all areas of track and field.
152232: The great-granddaughter of Kure Erioh, and a member of the main branch of the Kure Clan.
169178: Kanoh Agito was the affiliated fighter for Dainippon Bank and represented the company during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament; he was widely regarded as the most powerful fighter in the tournament and was the favorite to win.
181282: Himuro is a notorious womanizer, and takes every opportunity to get girls' phone numbers and set up mixers with them, whether they are secretaries, ring girls, or even Katahara Sayaka.
187552: Katahara Sayaka is the daughter of Katahara Metsudo, half-sister of Katahara Retsudo, and announcer for the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
187555: Katahara Metsudo is the director of Dainippon Bank and the former chairman of the Kengan Association. He currently acts as the adviser for the Kengan Association.
187556: Kure Fusui known as "The Wicked Shooter" (魔弾の射手, Mahi no Ite),[2] is an assassin and a member of the famed Kure Clan. She is also the younger sister of Kure Raian.
187557: Kure Erioh was the patriarch of the Kure Clan and also the former fighter of former Kengan Association chairman, Katahara Metsudo.
189695: Prominent member of the Kure Clan and is also Hollis' uncle.
189945: Tokita Niko (十鬼蛇 二虎) was Tokita Ohma's master and adoptive father, and founder of the Niko Style. In reality, "Tokita Niko" was never his real name, but rather an alias being used by the students of the true creator of the Niko Style, his master Gaoh Mukaku.
189955: Kureishi Mitsuyo (暮石光世) is Imai Cosmo, Adam Dudley and Nozomi Tenma's master, an MMA fighter and a chiropractor.
189956: Jerry Tyson (ジェリー・タイソン), also known as the Rocket Man, was the affiliated fighter for 22nd FAX Corporation. After his loss in the Kengan Annihilation Tournament preliminaries, he joined Katahara Sayaka as a commentator for the tournament.
192332: Hiyama Shunka (檜山 瞬花, Hiyama Shunka; "Shunka Hiyama") is the CEO of Wakasa Life Insurance and a member of the Kengan Association.
192336: Nezu Masami, also known as "The Man from the Land of Dreams" (夢の国から来た男, Yume no Kuni kara kita Otoko), is a former underground martial arts fighter; he is the former reigning champion of Bishamon, and fought for Tochigi Destiny Land during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.
192432: Nishihonji Akira (西品治 明) is the CEO of Nishihonji Security Services, and a member of the Kengan Association. He is considerably younger than most association members, and he has a close relationship to his fighter, Imai Cosmo.
203344: Matsuda Tomoko is the board chair secretary of the Koyo Academy Group.
203345: Yamashita Kenzou is Yamashita Kazuo's eldest son and the shadow boss of Under Mount Inc. unbeknownst to the majority of the world.
203346: Yoshitake Yoshiro is the President of Yoshitake Real Estate and a member of the Kengan Association. He is considered the high-flying up-and-coming hope of the real estate industry.
203347: Hayami Katsumasa is the CEO of Toyo Electric Power Co. and head of the Society of a Hundred, the formerly largest faction within the Kengan Association.
203348: Hassad was the affiliated fighter for Persia Petroleum and one of the five candidates who successfully passed the Kengan Annihilation Tournament preliminaries. He is also the first in line to the throne of a small nation in the Middle East.
203349: Togo Tomari is the CEO of Iwami Heavy Industries and an influential Kengan Association member. She is regarded as a lunatic of the Japanese business community.
203350: Urita Sukizo is the CEO of Penasonic and a member of the Kengan Association.
203351: Kurayoshi Rino also known as the Queen Bee, is the representative of Gold Pleasure Group, and a member of the Kengan Association. She is a revolutionary of the night leisure industry who also commands the title of Queen of the Night.
203352: Komada Shigeru, also known as Komada the Deva King, is a yakuza and former affiliated fighter of the Nogi Group.
203353: Ivan Karaev, also known as The Russian Reaper, is a former Russian kickboxer who made headlines in recent times. He currently works at SF Cold Storage as vice president, alongside fellow vice president Komada Shigeru.
203354: Ohya Ken is the CEO of Ginokuniya Bookstore, a member of the Kengan Association, and a good friend of Yamashita Kazuo.
203355: Kure Hollis, also known as The Wailing Demon, is a prominent member of the notorious Kure Clan.
204999: Kokomi is a nurse at Teito University, and serves as an assistant for Hanafusa Hajime, often keeping his destructive urges in check.
205000: Yoshiko is the young CEO of Murder Music, a newer member of the Kengan Association and the youngest female executive in the Kengan Association.
205001: Elena is Mokichi Robinson's sister. Elena is a beautiful young woman with a deceptively defined physique, a small frame, with long flowing blonde hair and gentle blue eyes. She tends to wear dresses that goes down to her thighs, and stockings that match.
224755: Tadashi is the CEO of Yato Trading Co and a member of the Kengan Association. He is skilled at pushing through seemingly impossible demands and is one of the best "dealmakers", even in the Kengan Association.
283631: Ozu Toshio is the affiliated fighter of the Koyo Academy Group as well as the Associate Professor of English Literature in the Department of English Literature at the Koyo Women's University.
